title: Structurally modified dipyrazinylpyridine-based homoleptic Cu(II) complexes: comparative cytotoxic evaluation in breast cancer cell lines.
authors: Roy, Indrajit; L, Karthikeyan; Deb, Sourav; Rathnam, Sharan Shanmuga Vuppaladadium; Jangra, Jitender; Patra, Snehashish; Anindya, Roy; Maji, Somnath
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Cu(II)配合物与DNA的结合及细胞毒性，虽涉及DNA互作和分子对接，但对象为小分子金属配合物而非蛋白质-DNA体系，且方法以实验为主，仅分子对接为辅助，与TF-DNA互作建模课题关联较弱。
abstract: The DNA interaction ability of transition metal complexes is closely related to their ligand structure, which plays a crucial role in therapeutic applications. In this context, two mononuclear homoleptic Cu(II) complexes, [Cu(L1)(2)](ClO(4))(2), 1, and [Cu(L2)(2)](ClO(4))(2), 2 (where L1 = 4-(2,6-di(pyrazin-2-yl)pyridin-4-yl)-N,N-dimethylaniline and L2 = 4-(2,6-di(pyrazin-2-yl)pyridin-4-yl)-N,N-diphenylaniline), were synthesised and characterised using various spectroscopic and analytical techniques. SCXRD data indicate that in both complexes, the central Cu(II) unit is oriented in a distorted octahedral manner. The redox performance of the complexes was investigated using various voltammetric techniques. The DNA-binding ability of the complex was investigated using absorbance spectroscopy and ethidium bromide (EB) fluorescence quenching studies with double-stranded salmon sperm DNA (ss-DNA). The binding constant (K(b)) and Stern-Volmer constant (K(sv)) were obtained in the range of 10(4) M(-1). Molecular docking studies were performed to understand the interactions between B-DNA and the complexes. Furthermore, DNA nicking activity was monitored by in vitro electrophoresis analysis of the supercoiled plasmid DNA. The effects of cell viability on MCF-7 and MDA-MB-231 cell lines were investigated. Cellular production of reactive oxygen species (ROS) was determined using a fluorescent probe (Calcein-AM). Notably, co-administration of 1 with Camptothecin (CPT) enhanced the overall cytotoxic effect, suggesting a synergistic therapeutic response. Interestingly, these results could lead to the development of cost-effective non-platinum transition metal-based chemotherapeutic agents to overcome the lacuna of the present conventional drugs.
abstract_zh: 过渡金属配合物的DNA相互作用能力与其配体结构密切相关，这在治疗应用中起着关键作用。在此背景下，合成了两种单核同配型Cu(II)配合物，[Cu(L1)(2)](ClO(4))(2)，1，和[Cu(L2)(2)](ClO(4))(2)，2（其中L1 = 4-(2,6-二(吡嗪-2-基)吡啶-4-基)-N,N-二甲基苯胺，L2 = 4-(2,6-二(吡嗪-2-基)吡啶-4-基)-N,N-二苯基苯胺），并通过多种光谱和分析技术进行了表征。SCXRD数据表明，在两种配合物中，中心Cu(II)单元呈畸变八面体取向。使用各种伏安技术研究了配合物的氧化还原性能。通过吸收光谱和溴化乙锭（EB）荧光猝灭研究，使用双链鲑鱼精子DNA（ss-DNA）考察了配合物的DNA结合能力。结合常数（K(b)）和Stern-Volmer常数（K(sv)）在10(4) M(-1)范围内获得。进行了分子对接研究以理解B-DNA与配合物之间的相互作用。此外，通过超螺旋质粒DNA的体外电泳分析监测了DNA切割活性。研究了细胞活力对MCF-7和MDA-MB-231细胞系的影响。使用荧光探针（Calcein-AM）测定了细胞活性氧（ROS）的产生。值得注意的是，1与喜树碱（CPT）的联合给药增强了整体细胞毒性效应，表明存在协同治疗反应。有趣的是，这些结果可能有助于开发成本效益高的非铂过渡金属基化疗药物，以克服现有常规药物的不足。
